name: ruling-9-a-held-value-outside-its-range-refuses-even-unwritten
reference: spec 0.56 ruling 9: decode of conformance-range-json gives probe.x 5 and probe.y 4095. On encode, v would be written from probe.x (ruling 16 of 0.5), but probe.y is held and outside its range 0 10, so the encode is refused.
